title: Load rule homes and print update obligations from decisions log
action: Two parts. (1) Per D4, a reusable loader: new module src/verbs/knowledge/ownership.rs (register in knowledge/mod.rs) exposing `pub(crate) fn load_ownership(repo_root: &Path) -> Ownership` that walks docs/knowledge/ once and returns, per area, the `owns.code` / `owns.skills` / `owns.tests` lists from areas/<area>/overview.md, plus every rule home: {rule id, home path, areas, applied_at list} — reusing check.rs's frontmatter parse (frontmatter.rs:259 `parse_frontmatter`), marker extraction (rg -n 'fn extract_rule_markers' check.rs) and glob matching (check.rs:294 `match_glob_segment`); also `pub(crate) fn matches_owned(list: &[String], path: &str) -> bool` for trailing-* globs. For the AGENTS.md homes, read the 'AGENTS.md rule homes' section of docs/knowledge/areas/doctrine-layer/router-triage-and-the-agents-md-duplication-boundary.md (koh-4 put the applied_at list there) so `agents-*` rules load with home AGENTS.md. Unit-test the loader on a temp bundle. (2) Per D1's decision-log trigger: in src/verbs/decisions/verbs_read.rs:191 `run_log`, after the existing conflict_candidates insert at verbs_read.rs:738 `m.insert("conflict_candidates".into(), ...)`, resolve the new decision's --tags and --scope against the loaded rule homes (a rule matches when one of its areas equals a tag or the scope) and insert `update_obligations`: [{rule, home, applied_at: [..]}] — the union of files the agent now owes an update to; empty array when nothing matches; in the non-JSON path print one line per obligation. Update `decisions log` help in src/generated/registry_payload.json (rg -n '"decisions log"') to name the field, and the catalog count if the drift test moves. Sync the home spec docs/knowledge/areas/decision-memory/overview.md with the new output field. Tests in decisions/tests.rs: a log whose tag matches a homed rule's area carries that rule's applied_at; a log with no match carries [].
